answer.recommendation: Proposed retention schedule based only on the work packet: (1) Support tickets: retain for the default 3 years, owner Records Operations, review at the end of each 3-year retention period before disposal. (2) Billing records: retain for the default 3 years, owner Records Operations, review at the end of each 3-year retention period before disposal. Suggested review cadence: an annual check by Records Operations confirming both schedules are still current. Exact review calendar dates depend on each record's creation or closure date, which the packet does not provide, so they should be set when those trigger dates are known. Any record-type-specific retention period, legal hold, or named individual owner beyond Records Operations must be confirmed against the full policy before this schedule is adopted.
quality_notes: The work packet gives only two record types, a 3-year default, and a team owner; it does not state per-type retention periods, a retention trigger event, or specific review dates.
No specific review dates were set because no trigger dates were provided; the schedule uses relative review timing instead of inventing calendar dates.
Owner is assigned at team level (Records Operations) because no individual owner was named in the packet.
I did not contact colleagues for the full policy text; the recommendation should be verified against the complete policy before use.
Legal holds and any regulatory overrides for billing records were not addressed because the packet does not include them.
